Para operar, la institución usa proveedo: To operate, the institution uses providers that process data only on its behalf: hosting and database (Neon and AWS), the web app (Vercel), phone notifications (Expo) and email (Gmail). Some may process data outside Colombia (for example, in Brazil or the United States), under contracts requiring adequate protection. We only hand data to authorities that legally require it.
Aplicamos cifrado en tránsito y, en repo: We apply encryption in transit and, at rest, to the ID number, email, phone, blood type, biometric templates and excuse supporting documents, role-based access control and audit logs. We keep data while you are linked to the institution and for as long as the law requires; biometric verification logs are deleted after 90 days. No system is infallible: if an incident affecting your data occurs, the institution will handle it and inform the authority and data subjects as required by law.
